title: Karɔti kison laseginnikow
summary: I bɛna karɔti kison labɔcogo lɔn kɛnɛma : san kelen karɔti funtenimanw ni san fila karɔtiw danfara, dulɔkɔ caman sɛgɛsɛgɛli walasa ka bɛrɛw sugandi, ani ka bɔrɔkɔ jalenw kunkurunnaw kɛrɛnkɛrɛn ka kison saniyalenw sɔrɔ.

pages.title: Bisimila karɔti kison labɔli kalan kɔnɔ
pages.text:
Karɔti ye nakɔfɛn duman de ye min kɔnɔ fanga bɛɛ bɛ sɔrɔ, a ka di musow ni denmisɛnw fɛ ani a sɔngɔ ka ɲi sugu la.  
Ka i yɛrɛ ka karɔti kison labɔ o bɛ sira kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen de taama : walasa ka a lɔn ni dulɔkɔ bɛrɛ ye, fɔɔ ka dugukolo sɔgɔ ka a filɛ !  
Senkɔrɔta bɛɛ de bɛ kalan yan walasa ka kison caman sɔrɔ min bɛ bɛn an ka dugukolo ma.
pages.illustration_description: Sɛnɛkɛla bɛ karɔti labɔ dugukolo kɔnɔ.

pages.title: An bɛna min kalan
pages.text:
Nin kalan nin kɔnɔ, an bɛna hakili kɛ yɔrɔ lɔɔlu (5) de kan :
1. Karɔti firiw ni kungo karɔti ka ɲɔgɔnsɔrɔbali sababuw.
2. Karɔti suguw sugandili minnu bɛ bɛn funteni ma.
3. Kison labɔla ka gundow : dulɔkɔ sɔgɔli, a dabilali ni a sugandili.
4. Dulɔkɔ ɲumanw turu kokura ani ka jiri siri a firikolo la.
5. Kison jalenw laseginni, a susuli saniyasira la ani a mara fo san lɔɔlu.

pages.title: Kalan 1 : Firi kurunnaw ni ɲɔgɔnsɔrɔli
pages.text:
Karɔti firi bɛ bɔ i n'a fɔ sankurunba jɛlen min kɔnɔ firi misɛn caman bɛ jɛnlen kɛ.  
Firi misɛnnin kelenkelen tɛ se ka den di a yɛrɛ ma : dɔgɔkunw, liɲɛgɛnw ni sɔnsɔrw de bɛ firi mugu ta ka kɛnɛya don a la.

pages.title: Jantoli : Kungo karɔti ka farati !
pages.text:
⚠️ Nakɔ karɔti ni **kungo karɔti** bɛ se ka ɲɔgɔn ta kaba lakika la.  
Ni kungo karɔti firi ye i ka nakɔ karɔti ta, o san kura a dulɔkɔ bɛna jɛ, ka gɛlɛya, ka kɛ kɔrɔbɛntamaga ye min tɛ se ka dumi !  
✅ Kungo karɔti bɛɛ tigɛ ka bɔ nakɔ yɔrɔ la fo ka se mɛtiri 500 walasa ka kilɔmɛtiri 1 sɔrɔ.
pages.illustration_description: Nakɔ karɔti ni kungo karɔti danfara ja.

pages.title: Kalan 2 : Funteni karɔti suguw
pages.text:
Karɔti sugu fila de bɛ yen :
- Tlebi karɔtiw : olu mago bɛ nɛnɛba la walasa ka firi. Yan funteni duguw kɔnɔ, olu tɛ firi di abada !
- Kuroda karɔtiw (Kuroda, New Kuroda) : minnu bɛ se ka firi sɔrɔ bɛnbaliya tɛ kɛnɛ kan funteni la.  
✅ O kama, Kuroda suguw de bɛ sugandi nakɔ kɔnɔ.

pages.title: Kalan 3 : Dulɔkɔw sɔgɔli ka sugandi
pages.text:
Walasa ka kison ɲumanw sɔrɔ, i kana dulɔkɔ to dugu kɔnɔ gansan !
Ni a mɔna, dulɔkɔ 30 fo 50 sɔgɔ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin :
- Dulɔkɔ tilennenw, jɛlenw ni kɛnɛya ɲumanw sugandi.
- Minnu farala walasa ka fali olu gɛn.
- A dabilan tigɛ dɔɔnin ka a nɛnɛ filɛ ni a ka di.
- A dabilan tigɛlen don buguba kɔnɔ walasa fɔɲɔ kana a to ka fura.

pages.title: Kalan 4 : Dulɔkɔ bɛrɛw turu kokura
pages.text:
Dulɔkɔ sugandilenw bɛ kɛ bangebagaw ye :
1. Furaninw tigɛ ka to santimɛtiri 5 la.
2. A turu dugukolo fangatigi la, ka santimɛtiri 50 to u cɛ.
3. Ji di a ma ka ɲi.
4. Ni jiri kalanin janya la fo mɛtiri 1,5, a siri walasa fɔɲɔ kana a kari.

pages.title: Firiw ni kisonw mɔcogo
pages.text:
Firi kurunna fɔlɔ min bɛ bɔ cɛmancɛ la, o de bɛ kison belebelew ni fangatigiw di.  
Ni kisonw mɔna, firi kurunna bɛ korokoro i n'a fɔ kɔnɔ sow, a bɛ jɛ ka kɛ cɔkɔla ye.

pages.title: Kison kalaw sɔrɔli
pages.text:
A tigɛ sɔgɔma kɛnɛ la ni firi kurunnaw jalanna, ka kalanin santimɛtiri 5 to a la.  
Don bɔrɔ kɔnɔ ka bila sugu la dɔɔnin walasa a ka ja ka ɲi.

pages.title: Kisonw susuli ni a saniyali
pages.text:
Karɔti kisonw bɛ siri ɲɔgɔn na ka da a si misɛnninw kan !
Ka u fari ɲɔgɔn na :
1. Bolola fani don i bolo.
2. Firikurunw susu i bolow cɛ walasa tamisi kan.
3. Susuli nin bɛ si misɛnw kari.
4. Kisonw bɛ bɔ ɲɔgɔn na saniyalen ka bɛn danli ma.
pages.illustration_description: Bolow bɛ firikurun susu tamisi kan.

pages.title: Fɛfɛli ni a maracogo
pages.text:
Ka saniyali laban kɛ :
1. Kisonw don fɛlɛ walasa kurukuru kɔnɔ.
2. Fifi kɛ ka buguw fɛ.
3. Kison mara bɔkalu kɔnɔ ni bugunin dɔ ye.
4. Sɛbɛnni kɛ a kan.
5. 🌱 Karɔti kison bɛ mara fo **san 4 walasa san 5**.

pages.title: I ni baara ! Karɔti kison labɔli tora i bolo
pages.text:
I ni tɔgɔ ! Lɔnniyaba de ye sɛnɛ kɔnɔ : ka i yɛrɛ ka kison ɲuman labɔ !

I hakili to a la :
- ✅ Kuroda karɔtiw de sugandi funteni ma.
- ✅ Dulɔkɔ 30 fo 50 sɔgɔ ka nɛnɛ.
- ✅ Bugu don a dabilan tigɛlen na sani ka turu.
- ✅ A mabilba kungo karɔti la fo mɛtiri 500.
- ✅ Firi kurunna fɔlɔw jalenw de sɔrɔ.
